title: Runescape: Dragonwilds | 8:05 Kuldra | 1.0.0.6+ Legacy Run
author: Nano
offsetMethod: detected: end of the loading screen into the raid

textNotes.text: Run is Obsolete as of Patch 1.0.1, New Strats Here!: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=doVQ9Ph256g
Thanks to @SamFPlays for a large part of the routing (but not all of it :D), check out his sub 10 minute explainer video for some of the skips.

• The Zoop from Stronghold to Keep could have been stronger (I've made it with 0 Air/Phase Dash before), as well as the one to Kuldra (same story). I suspect the strength of the zoop is dependent on framerate where lower framerates give stronger zoops.
• The OOB Section can have cleaner Windsteps, skipping 2 Double Jumps.
• Need to test if clipping back through the ground at Kuldra is faster than respawning.
